residual_risks: Log-side-effect difference: GetEnvOrFile logs 'file X does not exist' for a missing *_FILE path. Old runProviderBackups read all five Bitbucket vars unconditionally; new collectProviderBackupResults short-circuits `bitbucketAPITokenDefined() || bitbucketOAuthDefined()`, so OAuth *_FILE read/log lines are skipped when API-token creds are complete. Cosmetic only, does not change which providers run.

Bitbucket startup compare-method log now uses strings.EqualFold (via logProviderCompareMethod) instead of strings.ToLower(x)=="refs"; differs only for exotic Unicode fold inputs (e.g. long-s). Display-only, negligible.
testing_gaps: No offline unit test exercises collectProviderBackupResults, the per-provider displayXStartupConfig log output, or checkProvidersDefined with both Bitbucket API-token and OAuth credentials set (the old map-order-dependent case); live-provider tests skip without credentials, so equivalence of provider order and log text rests on review only.
Dockerfile changes (merged adduser/apk layer, quoted URL) have no build-time verification in this review environment (no Docker).
